{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Nigeria|Cuisine of Nigeria]]

'''Nigerian peppered turkey wings''' is a side dish that can be eaten with rice in Nigeria. It is also eaten at parties.

== Ingredients ==
*6 [[Cookbook:Turkey|turkey]] wings
*2 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], peeled
*4 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] (optional)
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Dehydrated Broth|stock cube]], crushed
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
*2 medium red [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]]
*½ [[Cookbook:cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]

*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] or to taste

== Equipment ==
*[[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|Pots]]
*[[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]
*Bowl
*[[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]]

== Procedure ==
#Wash the turkey wings and put in a pot with 1 onion, garlic, ginger, stock cube, and thyme. Cover with water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
#Cook until the water dries up, then [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 200°C.
#Blend the bell pepper and remaining onion to get a smooth paste.
#Heat a small amount of vegetable oil in a pot. Add the pepper paste, and simmer until thickened and losing its raw flavor. Season with salt.
#Add the turkey wings to the sauce, and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat.

steps.text: Wash the turkey wings and put in a pot with 1 onion, garlic, ginger, stock cube, and thyme. Cover with water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cook until the water dries up, then bake in the oven at 200°C.
Blend the bell pepper and remaining onion to get a smooth paste.
Heat a small amount of vegetable oil in a pot. Add the pepper paste, and simmer until thickened and losing its raw flavor. Season with salt.
Add the turkey wings to the sauce, and toss to coat.
